headline: Inflation and Rate Hike Concerns Loom; Institutions Shift Hedging Toward 4 Key Groups - Finance
summary: Renewed US-Iran tensions have blockaded the Strait of Hormuz and pushed international crude above $90 a barrel. The Federal Reserve will decide on a possible rate hike on the 17th.
why: The Strait of Hormuz carries a large share of global seaborne oil, so disruptions there quickly affect crude prices, inflation expectations and central bank policy.
why_moved: A blockade of the Strait of Hormuz threatens oil supply, and the source reports crude rising above $90 a barrel, raising inflation concerns ahead of a Fed decision.
